turns.content: How often does the tenant limiter refill its token buckets?

golden.final_answer_criteria: States the tenant limiter refills on a 350 millisecond tick. Equivalent phrasings (350ms, 0.35 seconds, roughly three times a second) are acceptable when the 350ms figure is stated. The 900ms shadow-profile tick named in the pasted scrape scores 0. An answer presenting both the correct and a competing value without committing to one scores 0.
